What if an animal believed to be extinct is still out there? For wildlife biologist Forrest Galante, that's a possibility worth pursuing. Travelling into remote locations and following leads, he takes on the challenge of finding missing species that the world may have lost sight of. And when it comes to an animal mystery, he isn't one to give up easily.
Watch Extinct Or Alive Season 1 Episodes 8, 1, 2, 4, 7, 3 & 5 now on Animal Planet India!
